score: MetaboHealth (Deelen J et al. A metabolic profile of all-cause mortality risk identified in an observational study of 44,168 individuals. Nat Commun 2019;10:3346; open access CC BY 4.0)
formula: score = sum_i beta_i * (ln(x_i) - logMEAN_i) / logSD_i  (x in Nightingale 2016-platform units; xxl_vldl_l uses ln(x + 1), see note)
betas_source: Deelen 2019 multivariate model coefficients, as tabulated in MiMIR 1.5 data/mort_betas.rda (values transcribed; numbers are published results)
reference_source: BBMRI-NL Nightingale metabolomics summary statistics shipped with MiMIR 1.5 (Bizzarri D et al.): data/PARAM_metaboAge.rda logMEAN/logSD for 13 markers; xxl_vldl_l is absent there and was derived from data/BBMRI_hist.rda (31,056 samples) as mean/SD of ln(x+1) over histogram mid-points (approximation)
note_zh: Deelen 2019 在每个队列内部做 log 后标准化，存在 0 值的指标先整体加 1。单人无法做队列内标准化，故用 BBMRI-NL（荷兰）人群的 log 均值与标准差代替；这是近似，人群差异会带来系统偏移。

xxl_vldl_l.label: Total lipids in chylomicrons and XXL-VLDL

licence: Coefficients: published results (CC BY 4.0 article). Reference means/SDs: numerical summaries taken from MiMIR (GPL-3) data objects; no MiMIR code is included.
